mnemolith.jei.composition.hint: Вкладіть уламки пам'яті в барабан і поверніть його, щоб скріпити формулу.
mnemolith.jei.upgrade.chorus: Збільшує кількість відгомонів, яких ви можете тримати (хор).
item.mnemolith.chronicle_lens.hint: Hold to read memory pressure as a pill above the hotbar. Sneak for the chunk state. Near archival strata the read reaches one chunk farther, and the stone glows. Sneak and use to blind moment replicants.
item.mnemolith.extraction_needle.hint: Use on a block to pull the strongest imprint into a slip. It rests for a moment between pulls. In a stratum chunk, an empty read also checks the neighbor chunks. Use on your own echo to unpick its graft.
item.mnemolith.archivist_bait.hint: Toss it near an archivist. It will go for the bait before your slips.
item.mnemolith.archival_tablet.hint: A vein of this stone bleeds a little pressure and lets the lens read farther.
mnemolith.gui.catalog_empty: Extract an imprint. The catalog keeps only what you have learned.
mnemolith.gui.compose_fail: The slips refuse to hold together.
item.mnemolith.catalog_fragment.hint: Use to open the tags and patterns you have already learned.
item.mnemolith.field_guide.hint: Use to open illustrated notes on the memory loop.
item.mnemolith.echo_slip.hint: Use to record yourself. Recording runs for 25 seconds: movement, look, swings, broken and placed blocks, levers, buttons and doors. Use again to stop early.
item.mnemolith.echo_chorus_slip.hint: Use to absorb: you may keep one more echo.
item.mnemolith.echo_long_slip.hint: Use to absorb: echo recordings get 10 seconds longer.
item.mnemolith.echo_sturdy_slip.hint: Use to absorb: your echoes get more health.
item.mnemolith.echo_recording.hint: Use near where it was recorded to call an echo that replays it. Use it on your echo to re-teach it.
item.mnemolith.chronicle_lens.echo_hint: Hold use for the thermal view: the world turns dark pink and echoes glow through walls. Aim at your echo and attack to possess it.
mnemolith.gui.echo.mode.replay.tip: Replay the recording exactly, as in stage 1.
mnemolith.gui.echo.mode.mine.tip: Find and mine the taught blocks within the radius around the current spot. Needs a suitable pickaxe in the echo's inventory.
